svg.title: tme_agent multi-agent discovery architecture
svg.desc: Four-panel architecture diagram. A: data resources (public resources, multi-omics inputs, clinical and tissue context). B: closed-loop discovery lifecycle around an LLM orchestrator on LangGraph. C: hypothesis-to-action from hypothesis and action spaces through clinical and molecular context to report, hypotheses and figures. D: multi-agent discovery workflow with planning, data-QC, specialist execution, integration and evaluation agents under human review.
